title: 第四十六章秘境开始第四十五章剑痴
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
lines: 嘈杂声在人群中散开，毕竟这里的人可不是什么经历过大世面的宗门子弟，更远远比不上最前方那些内门弟子。
他们只是一些炮灰，一些在这场密境中要献出生命的罪修。
他们什么也不知道，只知道要活命就得跑。
沙虫越来越近，张守安甚至能感觉到这艘巨舟突然震了一下，看来是直接撞了上来。
紧接而来的就是一股腥臭味，张守安下意识地猜测起这个妖物的境界。
不过，就这体型，这般实力，最少也是筑基，自己完全就不是能打过的样子。
最多再指望一下那带队的三人，若是他们也不敌，自己便趁乱逃跑，哪怕是一次性将今天的三个血影闪全用掉都不在话下。
张守安下意识后退半步，立即避开众人，跑向甲板后侧。
不过就在途中，他却注意到一道身影朝船头走去，嘴里呢喃着：
“不好意思啊，沙虫老弟，曹斌那老东西拿酒贿赂我了。”
“说是把你灭了，就给我一壶酒喝。”
“我原本都懒得管的，谁能想到，他拿酒说事。”他一手握在腰间的剑柄上，而后稍稍用力，一把有些铁锈的长剑便从那截毁坏大半的剑鞘中抽出。
看起来普普通通，甚至是完全来混日子的模样，根本完全无法和那个敢向结丹出剑的人结合。
他一步跨上飞舟的最前方，而后不顾飞舟的晃荡，低头俯视了一眼底下的沙虫。
下一秒，沙虫再次袭来，这一次攻势更加猛烈，看来要一次性撞破飞舟。
谢遥呼出一口气，看着冲来的沙虫，手腕轻轻一抖，锈迹斑斑的长剑在空中一挥，无事发生。
不过就在几秒后，那个不顾一切的沙虫却是一下子从中间分开，一分为二。
而从中间的缺口处，有道道绿色血液炸裂开来。
“啪嗒”张守安能明显听见沙虫尸体摔在地上的巨响，而后是一道悠长的归剑入鞘之声。
张守安转头看去，只见谢遥加快了些脚步，朝船舱走去，嘴里还是不时地小声呢喃着：“小酒，小酒。”
张守安喉结滚动了一下，脑中不断重现刚才出剑的身影，心里暗自比较。
硬要说的话，自己当初用尽全力，抵挡姜成鸿的那招，倒是有几分相似。
只不过两者间的威力之差，完全不在一个水平。
飞舟行驶了差不多一天一夜，便到了目的地。
此刻底下已经人满为患，挤满了各宗前来参与秘境的弟子。
其中的宗门倒是不少，平时动不动就打生打死的正魔两派宗门，此刻倒是和谐不少。只不过这两个势力倒是直接从中间分开，有种井水不犯河水的感觉。
张守安凭借着之前向刘全打听到的信息，对这些门派有了大致的了解。
首先是最远方的蓝色衣服那堆，都是真武门的人，也就是魏霄那些人所在的宗门。
他们自然是正道大宗，隶属于正一道统下，与其他四个正道宗门一起维护着这片大陆的和平。
至于魔门，他们倒是没算上，毕竟那些人可是摧毁和平的罪魁祸首。
在其旁边，有一伙全是绿色衣服的队伍，他们队伍没有真武门那般整齐，但整体看来也差不了多少。
据张守安回忆，这应该是蜀山，同样的正道宗门。
content_en:
The noise dispersed among the crowd. After all, the people here were not disciples of the sect who had experienced the world, and they were far inferior to the inner disciples at the front.
They are just cannon fodder, some criminal cultivators who have to sacrifice their lives in this secret realm.
They knew nothing but that they had to run if they wanted to stay alive.
The sandworms were getting closer and closer, and Zhang Shou'an could even feel the giant boat shaking suddenly, and it seemed that it had hit it directly.
What followed was a fishy smell, and Zhang Shou'an subconsciously guessed the realm of this monster.
However, with this size and strength, it was at least foundation building, so there was no way he could beat him.
The most he could hope for was the three people leading the team. If they were no match for him, he would take advantage of the chaos and escape, even if he had to use up all three of today's Blood Shadow Flashes at once.
Zhang Shouan subconsciously took half a step back, immediately avoided everyone, and ran to the back of the deck.
But on the way, he noticed a figure walking towards the bow of the ship, murmuring:
"Sorry, brother Sandworm, that old guy Cao Bin bribed me with wine."
"If I say I want to kill you, give me a jug of wine to drink."
"I was too lazy to care. Who would have thought that he would talk about wine." He held the hilt of the sword at his waist with one hand, and then with a little force, a rusty long sword was pulled out from the mostly damaged scabbard.
He looks ordinary, even just messing around, and there is absolutely no way he can be combined with the person who dares to draw a sword against Jie Dan.
He stepped onto the front of the flying boat, and then ignored the swaying of the flying boat and looked down at the sandworms underneath.
The next second, the sandworms attacked again, this time the attack was more fierce, and it seemed that they were going to destroy the flying boat at once.
Xie Yao breathed out, looked at the charging sandworm, flicked his wrist, and waved the rusty long sword in the air. Nothing happened.
But just a few seconds later, the desperate sandworm suddenly separated from the middle and split into two.
From the gap in the middle, green blood exploded.
"Pah!" Zhang Shou'an could clearly hear the loud sound of the sandworm's corpse falling to the ground, followed by a long sound of the sword being sheathed.
Zhang Shou'an turned around and saw Xie Yao speeding up his pace and walking towards the cabin, still murmuring in a low voice from time to time: "Little wine, little wine."
Zhang Shou'an's Adam's apple rolled, and the figure who just drew the sword kept reappearing in his mind, comparing it secretly in his heart.
If I had to say it, the move he used with all his strength to resist Jiang Chenghong was somewhat similar.
It's just that the difference in power between the two is not at the same level at all.
…
The flying boat traveled for almost a day and a night before reaching its destination.
At this moment, the place was already overcrowded, packed with disciples from various sects who came to participate in the secret realm.
There are quite a few sects among them, and the two sects of good and evil, which usually fight life and death at every turn, are quite harmonious at the moment. It's just that these two forces are separated directly in the middle, and there is a feeling that the water in the well does not interfere with the river.
Zhang Shou'an had a general understanding of these sects based on the information he had obtained from Liu Quan before.
First of all, the pile of blue clothes in the farthest corner are all people from the Zhenwu Sect, which is the sect where Wei Xiao's people are from.
They are naturally the main sects of the Righteous Way and belong to the Righteous Way. Together with the other four sects of the Righteous Way, they maintain the peace of this continent.
As for the Demon Sect, they didn't count it. After all, those people were the main culprits in destroying peace.
Next to it, there was a team all dressed in green. Their team was not as neat as the Zhenwu Sect, but overall it looked about the same.
According to Zhang Shou'an's recollection, this should be Shushan, the same righteous sect.
